coverage: Full normal playthrough from empty saved data: Title (Start) -> map -> level_01 -> chat -> Results -> recommend solution_id -> Outcome -> 'Next level ->' through level_20 -> 'Continue ->' -> Ending part 1 and part 2 -> map. No page or console errors in the whole run (run_2.mjs, 185 screenshots).

Every level 01-20: chat played to the end with Enter, 'Find a place' only reached after the last message, solution card found and recommended, Outcome showed PERFECT MATCH and 3 of 3 stars every time.

One-time cards as they happen: chapter intros 1-4 each shown once at the first level of the chapter; How to play (3 steps) once at level_01; new-friend cards for Liam, Cyrus (01), Maya (02), Mina (03), Brooke (04), Roxy (06), each once; Scrapbook page cards at levels 01, 02, 03, 06, 10 (5/5), each once; no cards on replays of level_01 and level_20.
District unlock: with levels 01-04 done Downtown is LOCKED and clicking it does nothing; after a perfect level_05, opening level_06 and going back, Downtown shows 0 / 15 and lists LEVEL 6.

After the ending: all four districts open at 15 / 15, top-right total 60 / 60, every chapter marked PERFECT, Scrapbook 5/5, Friends met 6/6; replaying level_20 perfectly shows 'Back to levels' instead of 'Continue ->' and the ending does not play again.
Ending: part 1 group chat lines, 6 portraits, 'The End' 60 / 60; Esc moves to part 2 (send-off photo, roll call of six); Esc goes back to the map.

Outcome on replays: partial pick (level_02 Taco Loft) gives CLEARED, 2 of 3 stars, 'Missed: Budget', buttons Clue recap / Reread the chat / Try again / Next level; fail pick (Mole Cantina) gives OH NO..., 0 stars, peanut hint, buttons Clue recap / Reread / Try again / Levels; best stars stay 3.
Sounds on Outcome (hooked sound.play): perfect = 1 result sound + 3 star sounds, partial = 1 + 2, fail = 1; no doubles.
'Reread the chat' opens the full chat; Enter there goes back to the Results list.
Results: BEEN HERE / SEEN BEFORE pills on level_20 (Tidewater picked in level_16, Breakwater seen in level_16) correct; none on first-time lists.
Scrapbook: 5 pages, arrow keys turn pages and wrap; the chapter 4 add-on line on The Trip Fund shows only once chapter 4 is reached (by design).

Options: Text size, Chat pace, High contrast, Music and Sound effects changed and survive a reload; Reset progress (in-game confirm) clears progress but keeps settings; after Reset, a perfect level_20 pick offers 'Continue ->' to the ending again.
Not covered in depth: chat starring/unstarring, every chat pace, sorting/filtering, Credits, Volume 0, Animations off.

bugs.title: Map opens on the last district clicked, not the district of the level just played
bugs.where: Menu (level map), after leaving a level with '← Levels' or after the Ending
steps: Start with levels 01-04 done (or play them). Title -> Start: the map shows Campus.
Open LEVEL 5 from the map, recommend Basil Hearth, close the Scrapbook card, press 'Next level ->'.
Level 6 (Downtown) opens with the Chapter 2 card; close it and press '← Levels'.
bugs.expected: The map shows the district of the level just visited (Downtown, with LEVEL 6), as the checklist says the chosen district is remembered after visiting a level.
bugs.actual: The map shows CHAPTER 1 · CAMPUS QUARTER and levels 1-5; the player has to click Downtown to find the level they were just in. Same after the full playthrough: after the Ending, Esc lands on Campus, not Waterfront. The map only remembers the district last clicked on the map (registry 'menuChapter'); 'Next level ->' into a new chapter never updates it.
bugs.frequency: every time (2 of 2: level_06 via '← Levels', and after the Ending)

bugs.title: Options toggles are in a different order: 'Off | On' for High contrast and Animations, 'On | Off' for Music and Sound effects
steps: From the map press O (or click Options).
Compare the two pills on the High contrast and Animations rows with those on the Music and Sound effects rows.
bugs.expected: Every on/off setting puts its pills in the same order, so the right arrow always means the same thing.
bugs.actual: High contrast and Animations read 'Off  On'; Music and Sound effects read 'On  Off'. With the keyboard (left/right change a setting) the same key turns some settings on and others off.

not_bugs: No page or console errors in any run.
Stars, result titles and star totals matched the pick every time; map badges, chapter heading and top-right total always agreed (12/15 vs 12/60, 15/15 vs 60/60, 57/60).
Clicking a LOCKED district does nothing; districts unlock when their first level opens.
Each unlock card (friend, Scrapbook page, chapter intro, How to play) shows once and never on a replay.
The Outcome's main buttons don't react while an unlock card is up: the card is modal, close it first (by design).
Right after closing the Chapter 1 card, the card fades out while How to play fades in, so both are briefly on screen (004_level_01_chat_after1.jpg); it settles in a moment.
layoutProblems flagged 'off screen' / 'overlap' for many chat lines and reviews: these are inside scroll areas and are masked; the screenshots look correct.
The answer was listed first in the Results list on level_01, level_11 and level_17: the list is a seeded shuffle, so this is chance, not a giveaway.
Liam's small chat portrait looks darker than his friend-card art at 36 px; the portrait files are the same character.
Small coloured squares on the map's left edge and below the Night Market badge are painted into the map picture, not UI.
The Friends button is orange (Mina's colour) by design, not a notification.
feedback: Playing straight through with 'Next level ->' never shows the map, so a new district unlocking is only announced by the chapter card, and '← Levels' then drops you back in Campus; also on a fail the focus ring sits on 'Levels' rather than 'Try again', so pressing Enter after a mistake takes you out of the level.
